rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address printed under 'National Council / Bangalore 18 June, 1993', in the section the compilation heads 'SHRI LK ADVANI', the speaker, whom the text does not name, thanks the 'members of the BJP National Council, for the confidence reposed in me, and for having elected me once again President of this great Party'.

locator.item: National Council / Bangalore 18 June, 1993, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says the speaker is 'particularly grateful to Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi who proposed my name for this high office'.

locator.item: National Council / Bangalore 18 June, 1993, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says of Dr. Joshi: 'Under his stewardship the party has made immense strides during the past two and a half years'.

locator.item: National Council / Bangalore 18 June, 1993, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address printed under 'National Council / Mumbai 10 November, 1995' in the same section, the speaker, whom the text does not name, expresses gratitude to the delegates 'for having elected me the President of this great Party for yet another term'.

locator.item: National Council / Mumbai 10 November, 1995, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 11 April, 1998' the speaker, whom the text does not name, says it 'happens to be the last full-fledged meeting of the National Executive during my tenure as the Party President'.

locator.item: National Executive / New Delhi 11 April, 1998, first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address printed under 'National Executive / Gandhinagar 2 May, 1998' the speaker, whom the text does not name, says: 'For whatever has been left unaccomplished, I as President, own full responsibility'.

locator.item: National Executive / Gandhinagar 2 May, 1998: first paragraph of p.318

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says 'tomorrow marks an important day in my own personal calendar. As I hand over the baton of presidency to Shri Kushabhauji, an unforgettable chapter in my own life will come to a close'; on the next page the speaker says, in the present tense, 'As I lay down my responsibility as President, my memory dates back to the Jana Sangh days'.

locator.item: National Executive, Gandhinagar 2 May, 1998: fourth paragraph (p.317) and 'Evolution of BJP into a Powerful Force' (p.318)

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says the Gandhinagar session of the National Council 'will give the Party a new President, Shri Kushabhau Thakre, who has been elected unanimously to this post'.

locator.item: National Executive / Gandhinagar 2 May, 1998: third paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The address opens with the salutation 'Prime Minister Shri Atal Bihari Vajapyee, President-elect Shri Kushabhau Thakre, and esteemed colleagues'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Near its end the same address says 'Even as I take leave of you as Party President, I warmly welcome Shri Kushabhau Thakre, the new President-elect'.

locator.item: National Executive, Gandhinagar 2 May, 1998: 'Party will Prosper under Thakreji's Leadership'
